summary: Eastman Chemical filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a benchmark offering of senior unsecured notes, with coupon, maturity, principal amount and pricing left blank pending completion. Terms sketched include semi-annual interest beginning 2027, optional make-whole-style redemption before maturity, a change-of-control repurchase right at 101% of principal, denominations of $2,000 and $1,000 multiples, no sinking fund and no exchange listing. Joint book-running managers are Citigroup, Mizuho, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo Securities. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size, spread to Treasuries and use-of-proceeds language for leverage or refinancing signals.
